integrity: The claim is supported by the displayed tensor construction, the verified structural hypotheses of the cited theorem, and elementary series comparisons. All auxiliary cited lemmas are attributed to their sources. No independent mathematical validation or authorship claim.
scientific_limitations: The closed-space realization is in a separately constructed real dual and concerns simultaneous sequence-level original, subsequence and normalized-block density spectra. It does not classify arbitrary triple spectra, fixed preduals, or the unattainable basic closed endpoint [1, infinity). The proof uses the published Lorentz weight criterion and its classical block domination premise; independent publication-priority confirmation is not performed.
title: Spaceable closed and empty summability-selection spectra via projective tensors
